scope: Real public PR snapshot validation and static navigation census; not a human comprehension study.

selection.initial: First three selected modest Hono/Zod behavior changes; purposive examples.
selection.extensionRule: One latest merged PR touching at least5 non-declaration TS/TSX files from each of Excalidraw, Nest, TanStack Query. Seed latest50 listed PRs; query all merged since seed date, sort mergedAt descending, choose first qualifying PR. Selection is independent of analyzer output.

method.acquisition: Official HTTPS Git clones; PR heads fetched by refs/pull/<number>/head; hooks and global/system Git configuration disabled for checkout. No reviewed code, project scripts, hooks, or dependencies executed.
independentChecks: Pinned GitHub PR metadata and independent merge-base.
Git file inventory/per-file numstat and hunk positions.
Every resolved call from changed units checked against caller expression and target text/ranges read independently with git show.
Independent changed-line total compared with exact edit census and ownership.
Static peek share and induced changed-declaration components computed from report records.
Representative generated offline readers exercised in Chromium.
method.reproduction: See REAL-PR-VALIDATION.md; local reusable clones and scripts are ignored under tmp/real-pr-validation.

findings.description: Final release review found that lossy UTF8path decoding could silently misname entries; Git inventory/tree paths now use fatalUTF8 decoding and refuse unsupported filename bytes. Blob decoding preserves an initial UTF8BOM. The separate adversarial suite covers changed/unchanged invalid-byte filenames and BOM snapshot/edit preservation; public samples are unaffected.

Broader samples exposed recomputed JS diff alignment differences: Excalidraw cropElement.ts was154+/423- versus Git155+/424-, and Hono request.test.ts blank-line ownership differed. Git-native ledger is required to preserve authoritative edit positions. Current exact checks all pass.

Hono #5547 inserted repeated calls previously labeled later unchanged call sites added. Matching unchanged lines first fixed the bug. Real after1243 call is retained; all27 added starts from changed units fall on inserted lines.
Runtime instance methods, dynamic properties and property-initialized arrow functions are unsupported static targets. Callback-only tests remain in raw file units.
Whole-repository unresolved count includes both snapshots and is not a change-specific defect count. Large shared test functions can also dominate changed-unit call counts.
Extended configuration is not loaded; explicit diagnostics disclose potential inherited alias limitations.
